requirement: Brain proposes; Agent executes only through explicit capability/permission gates.
Brain output is never itself authorization.
Plans and executable commands are separate objects.
Runtime Agent policy hooks must be independent of model compliance.
Every action carries owner scope, run ID, project lock, permission set, and evidence requirement.
Tool outputs are untrusted until validated.
Agent stop/revoke must fence stale executors.
Sensitive context is minimized and purpose-bound.
Financial/credit data is not automatically exposed to every model/provider.
Financial action requires dedicated high-risk gate.
Credit source/model/report date remain attached to conclusions.
Suggestion, reminder creation, calendar change, purchase action, and communication are distinct permissions.
Sensitive reminder/notification content is redacted on lock screens unless owner opts in.
Generated content cannot silently cross accounts/companies.
Brain cannot "improve" locked assets without explicit reopening.
Security policy cannot be rewritten by model output.
AI-generated security recommendations remain proposals until governed.
Security logs are untrusted input to Brain, not instructions.
Recommendations require evidence, confidence, benefit, cost, effort, risk, dependencies, security impact, migration impact, QA, and success criteria.
Graph poisoning and stale-link detection required.
Model selection considers capability, security class, context sensitivity, cost policy, availability, and owner rules.
Provider fallback may not broaden sensitive-data exposure.
Local model is still untrusted computation.
Local inference receives only authorized context.
Only an explicitly authorized Agent mode may use its defined Work ladder.
Other modes park at Work boundary and produce a handoff state.
read vs modify vs pay/move-money vs product-opening permissions
bills/subscriptions can create reminders/Needs Me items without granting payment authority.
personal and business accounts stay separate
cash-preservation vs final-cost preferences remain trip-specific.
financial data can inform recommendations only with authorized scope.
project ID remains stable even if name changes
roadmap work units have stable IDs
Agent scope follows project ID, not fuzzy name matching.
security classification and permissions are mandatory metadata for capabilities and data.
security incident state can independently stop affected capability.
